request: Build a PyQt6 desktop app named NoteCanvas: a personal note canvas where notes are cards on a grid, each with a title, body, colour tag and pin state, persisted locally.
requirements: PyQt6; main.py launches the app; app/window.py: grid of note cards with add/edit/delete/pin, colour tags, and a search box filtering live; app/db.py: SQLite persistence (notes.db) with a schema migration on first run; app/theme.py: dark theme with a restrained accent palette; seed.py creating 6 sample notes; tests/ covering db CRUD; README.md with run instructions.
